slot.brief: Rank given ligands (CN−, F−, H2O, I−) by crystal field splitting strength using the spectrochemical series; straightforward ordering.

stem: Arrange the ligands in increasing order of crystal field splitting strength: $\text{I}^-$, $\text{F}^-$, $\text{H}_2\text{O}$ and $\text{CN}^-$.

verdicts.working: From the spectrochemical series, the splitting strength increases as I⁻ < F⁻ < H₂O < CN⁻.

working:
Spectrochemical series: $\text{I}^- < \text{F}^- < \text{H}_2\text{O} < \text{CN}^-$.

Independent check: From the spectrochemical series, the splitting strength increases as I⁻ < F⁻ < H₂O < CN⁻.
solution:
According to the spectrochemical series, ligand field splitting strength increases in the order
$$\text{I}^- < \text{F}^- < \text{H}_2\text{O} < \text{CN}^-$$
